        @cons.each_pair {|sock,val|
          if sock.step_idle > @timeout
            sock.close
          end
        }
      end
    end

    def multi_workers_ready?
      true
    end

    def start
      @_event_loop_run_timeout = @blocking_timeout

      super

      log.debug "listening http", bind: @bind, port: @port

      @km = KeepaliveManager.new(@keepalive_timeout)
      event_loop_attach(@km)

      server_create_connection(:in_http, @port, bind: @bind, backlog: @backlog, &method(:on_server_connect))
      @float_time_parser = Fluent::NumericTimeParser.new(:float)
    end

    def close
      server_wait_until_stop
      super
    end

    RES_TEXT_HEADER = {'Content-Type' => 'text/plain'}.freeze
    RESPONSE_200 = ["200 OK".freeze, RES_TEXT_HEADER, "".freeze].freeze
    RESPONSE_204 = ["204 No Content".freeze, {}.freeze].freeze
    RESPONSE_IMG = ["200 OK".freeze, {'Content-Type'=>'image/gif; charset=utf-8'}.freeze, EMPTY_GIF_IMAGE].freeze
    RES_400_STATUS = "400 Bad Request".freeze
    RES_500_STATUS = "500 Internal Server Error".freeze

    def on_request(path_info, params)
      begin
        path = path_info[1..-1]  # remove /
        tag = path.split('/').join('.')
        record_time, record = parse_params(params)

        # Skip nil record
        if record.nil?
          log.debug { "incoming event is invalid: path=#{path_info} params=#{params.to_json}" }
          return response_for_invalid_event
        end

        mes = nil
        # Support batched requests
        if record.is_a?(Array)
          mes = build_http_multi_event_stream(record, params)
        else
          add_params_to_record(record, params)
          time = resolve_http_event_time(record_time, record, params)
        end
      rescue => e
        if @dump_error_log
          log.error "failed to process request", error: e
        end
        return client_error_response(e)
      end

      # TODO server error
      begin
        if mes
          router.emit_stream(tag, mes)
        else
          router.emit(tag, time, record)
        end
      rescue => e
        if @dump_error_log
          log.error "failed to emit data", error: e
        end
        return server_error_response(e)
      end

      success_http_response
    end

    def self.shared_request_codec

    def bind_http_parser_codec(parser, usage, type)
      usage_name = usage.to_s
      type_name = type.to_s
      if usage_name.include?('json') || type_name == 'json'
        capture_json_parser_backend(parser)
      elsif usage_name.include?('msgpack') || type_name == 'msgpack'
        remember_msgpack_parser_backend(parser)
      else
        remember_generic_parser_backend(parser, usage_name, type_name)
      end
      parser
    end

    def capture_json_parser_backend(parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:parser] = parser
      if parser.respond_to?(:json_parser)
        state[:backend] = parser.json_parser
      end
      if parser.respond_to?(:stream_buffer_size)
        state[:stream_buffer] = parser.stream_buffer_size
      end
      state
    end

    def capture_msgpack_parser_backend(parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      state[:parser] = parser
      state[:binary_mode] = parser.respond_to?(:parser_type) ? parser.parser_type == :binary : true
      if parser.instance_variable_defined?(:@unpacker)
        state[:unpacker] = parser.instance_variable_get(:@unpacker)
      end
      state
    end

    def remember_generic_parser_backend(parser, usage_name, type_name)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      extras = state[:extras] ||= {}
      extras[usage_name] = { type: type_name, parser: parser }
      extras
    end

    def json_backend_pair(name)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      case name
      when :oj, 'oj'
        raise LoadError unless defined?(Oj) && Fluent::OjOptions.available?
        state[:backend] = :oj
        [Oj.method(:load), Oj::ParseError]
      when :json, 'json'
        state[:backend] = :json
        [JSON.method(:load), JSON::ParserError]
      when :yajl, 'yajl'
        state[:backend] = :yajl
        [Yajl.method(:load), Yajl::ParseError]
      else
        raise "BUG: unknown json parser specified: #{name}"
      end
    end

    def select_json_backend(name, logger = nil)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      begin
        pair = json_backend_pair(name)
      rescue LoadError => ex
        if logger
          if /\boj\z/ =~ ex.message
            logger.info "Oj is not installed, and failing back to Yajl for json parser"
          else
            logger.warn ex.message
          end
        end
        pair = json_backend_pair(:yajl)
      end
      state[:load_proc] = pair[0]
      state[:error_class] = pair[1]
      pair
    end

    def json_dump_proc_for(name, logger = nil)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      if name.to_s == 'oj'
        if Fluent::OjOptions.available?
          state[:dump_proc] = Oj.method(:dump)
        else
          logger.info "Oj isn't installed, fallback to Yajl as json parser" if logger
          state[:dump_proc] = Yajl.method(:dump)
        end
      else
        state[:dump_proc] = Yajl.method(:dump)
      end
      proc { |record| dump_json_record(record) }
    end

    def decode_json_with_parser(text, load_proc, error_class, execute_convert_values, parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:load_proc] = load_proc if load_proc
      state[:error_class] = error_class if error_class
      json_payload?(text)
      record = load_json_text(text)
      remember_json_error(nil)
      if record.is_a?(Hash)
        normalize_json_record(record)
      end
      time = parser.parse_time(record)
      if execute_convert_values
        time, record = parser.convert_values(time, record)
      end
      yield time, record
    rescue error_class, EncodingError => error
      remember_json_error(error)
      json_parse_error?(error, error_class)
      yield nil, nil
    end

    def decode_json_io_with_parser(io, parser, stream_buffer, &block)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:stream_buffer] = stream_buffer if stream_buffer
      buffer = json_stream_buffer_size
      y = Yajl::Parser.new
      y.on_parse_complete = ->(record) {
        block.call(parser.parse_time(record), record)
      }
      y.parse(io, buffer)
    end

    def normalize_json_record(record)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      if record.nil?
        state[:last_record] = nil
        return nil
      end
      if record.is_a?(Array)
        state[:last_record] = record.map { |item| item.is_a?(Hash) ? item : { 'value' => item } }
      elsif record.is_a?(Hash)
        state[:last_record] = record
      else
        state[:last_record] = { 'message' => record }
      end
      state[:last_record]
    end

    def json_parse_error?(error, error_class)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      klass = error_class || state[:error_class]
      if error.nil?
        false
      elsif klass && error.is_a?(klass)
        true
      elsif error.is_a?(EncodingError)
        true
      else
        false
      end
    end

    def json_stream_buffer_size
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      size = state[:stream_buffer].to_i
      if size <= 0
        state[:stream_buffer] = 8192
      elsif size > 1024 * 1024
        state[:stream_buffer] = 1024 * 1024
      else
        state[:stream_buffer] = size
      end
      state[:stream_buffer]
    end

    def fallback_json_backend(logger = nil)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      if state[:backend] == :oj && !Fluent::OjOptions.available?
        logger.info "Oj is not installed, and failing back to Yajl for json parser" if logger
        select_json_backend(:yajl, logger)
      elsif state[:load_proc].nil?
        select_json_backend(state[:backend] || :yajl, logger)
      else
        [state[:load_proc], state[:error_class]]
      end
    end

    def json_payload?(text)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      return false if text.nil? || text.empty?
      stripped = text.lstrip
      state[:looks_like_json] = stripped.start_with?('{') || stripped.start_with?('[')
      state[:looks_like_json]
    end

    def load_json_text(text)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      proc = state[:load_proc]
      if proc.nil?
        fallback_json_backend
        proc = state[:load_proc]
      end
      proc.call(text)
    end

    def dump_json_record(record)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      proc = state[:dump_proc] || json_dump_proc_for(state[:backend] || 'oj')
      proc.call(record)
    end

    def remember_json_error(error)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @json_codec_state
      state[:last_error] = error
      if error.nil?
        false
      else
        true
      end
    end

    def build_msgpack_unpacker
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      factory = state[:factory] || Fluent::MessagePackFactory.engine_factory
      state[:factory] = factory
      state[:unpacker] = factory.unpacker
      state[:unpacker]
    end

    def decode_msgpack_with_parser(data, unpacker, parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      used = unpacker || state[:unpacker] || recycle_msgpack_unpacker
      state[:unpacker] = used
      msgpack_binary_payload?(data)
      begin
        unpack_msgpack_chunk(data).each do |obj|
          if obj.is_a?(Hash)
            normalize_msgpack_record(obj)
          end
          yield parser.convert_values(parser.parse_time(obj), obj)
        end
      rescue => error
        msgpack_feed_error?(error)
        raise
      end
    end

    def decode_msgpack_io_with_parser(io, parser)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      unpacker = msgpack_unpacker_for_io(io)
      unpacker.each do |obj|
        time, record = parser.convert_values(parser.parse_time(obj), obj)
        yield time, record
      end
    end

    def reset_msgpack_codec
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      if state[:unpacker]
        begin
          state[:unpacker].reset if state[:unpacker].respond_to?(:reset)
        rescue
          state[:unpacker] = nil
        end
      end
      state[:unpacker] || build_msgpack_unpacker
    end

    def msgpack_object?(obj)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      if obj.is_a?(Hash)
        state[:last_kind] = :map
        true
      elsif obj.is_a?(Array)
        state[:last_kind] = :array
        true
      elsif obj.nil?
        state[:last_kind] = :nil
        false
      else
        state[:last_kind] = :scalar
        false
      end
    end

    def unpack_msgpack_chunk(data)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      unpacker = state[:unpacker] || build_msgpack_unpacker
      objects = []
      unpacker.feed_each(data) do |obj|
        msgpack_object?(obj)
        objects << obj
      end
      state[:last_objects] = objects
      objects
    end

    def msgpack_binary_payload?(data)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      if data.nil? || data.empty?
        state[:binary_mode] = false
        return false
      end
      encoding = data.encoding
      if encoding == Encoding::ASCII_8BIT || encoding == Encoding::BINARY
        state[:binary_mode] = true
      else
        state[:binary_mode] = data.bytesize != data.length || data.encoding != Encoding::UTF_8
      end
      state[:binary_mode]
    end

    def recycle_msgpack_unpacker
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      if state[:unpacker].nil?
        build_msgpack_unpacker
      elsif state[:unpacker].respond_to?(:reset)
        reset_msgpack_codec
      else
        state[:unpacker] = build_msgpack_unpacker
      end
    end

    def remember_msgpack_parser_backend(parser)
      capture_msgpack_parser_backend(parser)
    end

    def msgpack_unpacker_for_io(io)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      factory = state[:factory] || Fluent::MessagePackFactory.engine_factory
      state[:factory] = factory
      if io.nil?
        factory.unpacker
      else
        factory.unpacker(io)
      end
    end

    def normalize_msgpack_record(obj)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      if obj.is_a?(Hash)
        state[:last_record] = obj
      elsif obj.is_a?(Array)
        state[:last_record] = { 'items' => obj }
      elsif obj.nil?
        state[:last_record] = nil
      else
        state[:last_record] = { 'value' => obj }
      end
      state[:last_record]
    end

    def msgpack_feed_error?(error)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @msgpack_codec_state
      if error.nil?
        state[:last_error] = nil
        false
      else
        state[:last_error] = error
        true
      end
    end

    def default_http_content_types
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      state[:content_types] = {
        'json' => 'application/x-ndjson',
        'json:array' => 'application/json',
        'csv' => 'text/csv',
        'tsv' => 'text/tab-separated-values',
        'ltsv' => 'text/tab-separated-values',
        'msgpack' => 'application/x-msgpack',
        'out_file' => 'text/plain',
        'single_value' => 'text/plain',
        'stdout' => 'text/plain',
        'hash' => 'text/plain'
      }
      state[:content_types]
    end

    def content_type_for_formatter(type, json_array)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      mapping = state[:content_types]
      mapping = default_http_content_types if mapping.nil? || mapping.empty?
      key = json_array ? "#{type}:array" : type.to_s
      if type.to_s == 'json'
        mapping[key] = json_array ? 'application/json' : 'application/x-ndjson'
        classify_http_body(mapping[key], '')
        return mapping[key]
      end
      cached = mapping[type.to_s]
      if cached
        classify_http_body(cached, '')
        return cached
      end
      raise Fluent::ConfigError, "can't determine Content-Type from formatter type. Set content_type parameter explicitly"
    end

    def classify_http_body(content_type, body)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      params = {}
      if content_type.nil?
        state[:last_class] = :unknown
      elsif content_type =~ /^application\/json/
        params['json'] = body
        state[:last_class] = :json
      elsif content_type =~ /^application\/msgpack/
        params['msgpack'] = body
        state[:last_class] = :msgpack
      elsif content_type =~ /^application\/x-ndjson/
        params['ndjson'] = body
        state[:last_class] = :ndjson
      elsif content_type =~ /^application\/x-www-form-urlencoded/
        params.update WEBrick::HTTPUtils.parse_query(body)
        state[:last_class] = :form
      else
        state[:last_class] = :raw
      end
      params
    end

    def build_tls_client_options(settings)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      endpoint = settings[:endpoint].to_s
      use_ssl = endpoint.start_with?('https')
      opt = {
        open_timeout: settings[:open_timeout],
        read_timeout: settings[:read_timeout],
        ssl_timeout: settings[:ssl_timeout],
        use_ssl: use_ssl
      }
      if use_ssl
        opt = merge_tls_files(opt, settings)
        opt[:verify_mode] = tls_verify_mode_value(settings[:tls_verify_mode])
        opt[:ciphers] = settings[:tls_ciphers]
        opt[:ssl_version] = settings[:tls_version]
      end
      state[:tls] = opt
      opt
    end

    def merge_tls_files(opt, settings)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      if path = settings[:tls_ca_cert_path]
        raise Fluent::ConfigError, "tls_ca_cert_path is wrong: #{path}" unless File.file?(path)
        opt[:ca_file] = path
      end
      if cert_path = settings[:tls_client_cert_path]
        raise Fluent::ConfigError, "tls_client_cert_path is wrong: #{cert_path}" unless File.file?(cert_path)
        bundle = File.read(cert_path)
        bundle_certs = bundle.scan(/-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----(?:.|\n)+?-----END CERTIFICATE-----/)
        opt[:cert] = OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(bundle_certs[0])
        intermediate_certs = bundle_certs[1..-1]
        if intermediate_certs
          opt[:extra_chain_cert] = intermediate_certs.map { |cert| OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(cert) }
        end
      end
      if key_path = settings[:tls_private_key_path]
        raise Fluent::ConfigError, "tls_private_key_path is wrong: #{key_path}" unless File.file?(key_path)
        opt[:key] = OpenSSL::PKey.read(File.read(key_path), settings[:tls_private_key_passphrase])
      end
      state[:tls_files] = true
      opt
    end

    def tls_verify_mode_value(mode)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      value = case mode
              when :none
                OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE
              when :peer
                OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
              else
                OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER
              end
      state[:verify_mode] = value
      value
    end

    def http_method_class_for(http_method, uri)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      req = case http_method
            when :post
              Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.request_uri)
            when :put
              Net::HTTP::Put.new(uri.request_uri)
            else
              Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.request_uri)
            end
      state[:last_method] = http_method
      req
    end

    def apply_http_request_headers(req, settings, chunk)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      headers = settings[:headers]
      placeholder_headers = settings[:headers_from_placeholders]
      resolved = {}
      if placeholder_headers
        placeholder_headers.each do |k, v|
          resolved[k] = settings[:placeholder_lookup].call(v, chunk)
        end
      end
      merge_placeholder_headers(headers, resolved).each do |k, v|
        req[k] = v
      end
      req['Content-Type'] = settings[:content_type]
      state[:headers] = headers
      req
    end

    def format_http_request_body(chunk, json_array)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      body = if json_array
               "[#{chunk.read.chop}]"
             else
               chunk.read
             end
      state[:last_body_size] = body.bytesize
      body
    end

    def build_http_request_object(chunk, uri, settings)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      req = http_method_class_for(settings[:http_method], uri)
      if settings[:auth]
        req.basic_auth(settings[:auth].username, settings[:auth].password)
      end
      apply_http_request_headers(req, settings, chunk)
      req.body = format_http_request_body(chunk, settings[:json_array])
      state[:last_request] = req
      req
    end

    def retryable_http_response?(code, retryable_codes)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      codes = retryable_codes || []
      state[:retryable_codes] = codes
      codes.include?(code.to_i)
    end

    def interpret_http_response(res, settings, uri)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      if res.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
        settings[:logger].debug { "#{res.code} #{res.message.rstrip}#{res.body.lstrip}" } if settings[:logger]
        state[:last_status] = :success
        return res
      end
      msg = "#{res.code} #{res.message.rstrip} #{res.body.lstrip}"
      if retryable_http_response?(res.code, settings[:retryable_response_codes])
        state[:last_status] = :retryable
        raise settings[:retryable_error], msg
      end
      if settings[:error_response_as_unrecoverable]
        state[:last_status] = :unrecoverable
        raise Fluent::UnrecoverableError, msg
      else
        state[:last_status] = :logged_error
        settings[:logger].error "got error response from '#{settings[:http_method].to_s.capitalize} #{uri.to_s}' : #{msg}" if settings[:logger]
      end
      res
    end

    def send_formatted_http_request(uri, req, settings)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      proxy_uri = settings[:proxy_uri]
      if proxy_uri.nil?
        proxy_uri = http_proxy_tuple(settings[:proxy])
      end
      http_opt = settings[:http_opt]
      res = if proxy_uri
              Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, proxy_uri.host, proxy_uri.port, proxy_uri.user, proxy_uri.password, http_opt) { |http|
                http.request(req)
              }
            else
              Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port, http_opt) { |http|
                http.request(req)
              }
            end
      state[:last_uri] = uri.to_s
      interpret_http_response(res, settings, uri)
    end

    def http_proxy_tuple(proxy)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      if proxy.nil? || proxy.empty?
        state[:proxy] = nil
        return nil
      end
      state[:proxy] = URI.parse(proxy)
      state[:proxy]
    end

    def merge_placeholder_headers(base_headers, placeholder_headers)
      @payload_codec_context ||= {}
      state = @http_client_state
      merged = {}
      if base_headers
        base_headers.each { |k, v| merged[k] = v }
      end
      if placeholder_headers
        placeholder_headers.each { |k, v| merged[k] = v }
      end
      state[:headers] = merged
      merged
    end

    def prepare_cors_origin_cache(origins, credentials)
      state = @cors_engine_state
      list = origins ? origins.dup : []
      state[:origins] = list
      cors_credentials_allowed?(list, credentials)
      refresh_cors_wildcard_patterns(list)
      state[:preflight] = {}
      state
    end

    def cors_origin_permitted?(origin, origins)
      state = @cors_engine_state
      allow_list = origins || state[:origins] || []
      state[:origins] = allow_list
      if origin.nil?
        return false
